featured.intro: English Vocabulary Daily is a channel that teaches one English word in the morning and tests it with a quiz in the evening. The whole channel runs on GitHub Actions — a scheduled workflow picks the day's lesson deterministically and posts it, twice a day, every day. There is no AI at runtime, no server, and no manual posting: the {{data.lessonCount}}-lesson bank lives in the public repo, and the bot token and chat ID live only as GitHub Secrets, never in the code.
featured.oneLine: A channel that posts one English word in the morning and a quiz in the evening — fully automated on GitHub Free.
featured.result: Posts twice a day, every day, with zero manual work — schedule 07:15 and 17:15 UTC, verifiable in the repo's Actions history.
featured.title: English Vocabulary Daily

featured.intro: ChannelCraft Prompt Pack is a paid product: 120 AI prompts in 9 sections for running a Telegram channel, sold for $2 USDT on TON. The landing page is a static Cloudflare Pages site; a Cloudflare Worker handles orders, verifies the TON payment on-chain, and delivers the file through the Telegram bot — no server, no AI at runtime.
featured.oneLine: 120 AI prompts to run a Telegram channel — $2 USDT on TON, delivered by bot.
featured.result: Live product at telegram-channel-prompt-pack.pages.dev; 120 prompts, 28/28 worker tests passing; the Worker verifies each TON payment on-chain before delivery.
featured.title: ChannelCraft Prompt Pack

featured.intro: LiveForge is this portfolio itself: a bespoke single-page site in the GitHub-homepage dark idiom, built from live public GitHub data at build time. One Node standard-library script renders the page — no framework, no token — and every push redeploys it on Cloudflare Pages automatically.
featured.oneLine: This portfolio site — built from live GitHub data, deployed on Cloudflare Pages.
featured.result: Live at liveforge.pages.dev; builds with a single Node script, deploys on every push, refreshes its live data twice a day.
featured.title: LiveForge
